correctness.rationale: The trace pairing is nondegenerate in every characteristic. The Rota–Baxter equation is equivalent to A_0²=λA_0, BA_0=μB, A_0B=(λ−μ)B with μ(μ−λ)=0. This partitions the rank-one maps into square-zero output lines and lines containing a unique nontrivial idempotent. The square-zero matrix flag count and the complementary-subspace idempotent count are bijective, avoiding double counting. A standalone test exhaustively matches 5 small finite-field configurations, with 9055 direct identity evaluations; the proof is independent of these finite checks.
